channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Cornell Sorority Faces Lawsuit and Recusal Request
item.description: A Cornell University sorority is facing a lawsuit filed by one of its members. A second defendant in a related case involving a Cornell fraternity has requested the recusal of the New York Attorney General. The specific details of the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Woman Dies in Vaughan Hit-and-Run; Video Shows Final Moments
item.description: A woman died in a hit-and-run incident in Vaughan, with video footage capturing her movements seconds before the collision. Police are seeking three drivers in connection with the fatal incident. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: A Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) jawan died from gunshot injuries in Reasi district of Jammu and Kashmir. Officials stated that he later succumbed to his injuries. A probe has been ordered into the incident. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Delhi Police have informed Abhijeet Dipke of his grandmother's death and offered to facilitate his travel to his hometown to attend her last rites. The decision to travel rests with Dipke. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: Actor Imran Khan was detained by Mumbai Police during a protest at August Kranti Maidan. A video of the incident has gone viral. Khan was reportedly detained for participating in a protest organized by CJP. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: A cache of arms and ammunition was recovered from a forest area in Baramulla, Jammu and Kashmir. A Bomb Disposal Squad was called to the scene to examine and safely handle suspected explosive materials. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: A contempt petition has been filed in the Supreme Court alleging arbitrary metro station closures and train cancellations in Delhi, despite a court order. The plea specifically targets the Delhi Police chief. The closures and cancellations… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.description: The Central government has proposed stricter regulations for the advertising of prescription drugs by retailers and wholesalers. The Union Health Ministry is seeking to implement these tighter rules. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.description: French police tactics are facing scrutiny following injuries sustained by students during nationwide protests. Reports indicate at least one teenager suffered a broken jaw, drawing criticism of police conduct. The protests themselves are… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.description: A parliamentary panel has recommended significant reforms for the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) exam, including the implementation of digital question banks and a shift towards computer-based testing (CBT). The panel also… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: A ceiling collapse at a shopping mall in Daegu, South Korea, on Saturday morning injured 38 people. The incident occurred on the second floor of a four-story building around 10:16 AM, with approximately 70 people evacuated. Authorities… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Masked thieves carried out what is described as Italy's largest ever wine robbery last weekend at a warehouse in central Italy, stealing approximately 30,000 bottles. The stolen wine is valued at over $5.6 million, with some reports… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 8 · Right 1.

item.title: 21-year-old woman found dead in Melbourne apartment
item.description: A 21-year-old woman, identified as Jayda Allen Bonner, was found dead in an apartment in Carlton, Melbourne. Her aunt stated that the family had feared for her safety and that she was 'captured' before her death. The circumstances… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: A Delhi court has cancelled the interim bail granted to activist Sharjeel Imam. The Delhi Police had moved the court seeking cancellation, alleging that Imam had breached the conditions of his bail, specifically a media gag order. The case… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: ACP Accused of Harassment Promoted Amidst Allegations
item.description: An Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP) accused of sexually harassing a female journalist has received a promotion and been given the charge of Additional Deputy Commissioner of Police (DCP). The allegations surfaced during a protest at… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 4 · Right 2.

item.title: Two Delhi Police personnel injured during protest detentions
item.description: Two Delhi Police personnel, including a member of the Pink Force, were injured near the Kartavya Path and Akashwani Bhawan areas during the detention of protesters. The injuries occurred amidst stone pelting directed at police personnel. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Arsenal Manager Responds to Man City Verdict
item.description: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta has stated his conscience is clear following a guilty verdict against Manchester City. When pressed on the matter, Arteta provided a one-word answer regarding his conscience. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Court Convicts Ex-AAP Councillor Tahir Hussain in 2020 Delhi Riots Case
item.description: A court has convicted former Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) Councillor Tahir Hussain for abetment of rioting in connection with the 2020 Northeast Delhi riots. The conviction relates to a case linked to the riots. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 3.
